name: Architecture
description: City views, bridges, harbours, villas and quiet rooms in calm light, from Venetian views to Impressionist streets.

works.alt_text: A wide view of Piazza San Marco in Venice, with the ornate basilica on the left, the tall brick bell tower and long arcaded buildings under a pale sky.
The white houses and domes of Genoa spread down to a deep blue sea, seen from a green hillside with trees.
Waterloo Bridge in London dissolving into a lilac and blue haze, with glints of sunlight on its arches and the river.
A sunny beach street in Sitges lined with whitewashed houses, with barrels and timber on the sand and a church tower by the sea.
A loose watercolour of a pale Venetian palace front with arched doors and windows reflected in green canal water.
A small bedroom with blue walls, a wooden bed with a red cover, two yellow chairs, a table and an open green window.
A watercolour of an old stone bridge with two arches over a calm river, with poplars and a brick building on the right under a pale sky.
A watercolour of a Rhine town with a church spire and tiled roofs below green wooded hills, a sailing boat on the calm golden river.
A long arched stone aqueduct crossing behind a railway cutting with green trees and grass, and people strolling on the left.
A grey ink and wash drawing of an imaginary palace with a grand arched courtyard beside a lagoon, with a ship's masts beyond.
A New England village of white wooden houses and a steepled meetinghouse on a green hill under a blue sky with white clouds.
Waterloo Bridge in London on a grey day, its arches and the factory chimneys behind softened in blue-green mist.
Whitewashed Moorish buildings with arched green doors above a rough, pale stony foreground, in the soft light of a cloudy day.
Strollers, families and dogs under tall trees on the sunny paths of Boston Common, with the city's rooftops on the hill beyond.
The Brooklyn Bridge spanning a turquoise river above red brick rooftops under a golden evening sky.
A fine ink drawing of a villa with an ornate gateway and potted trees, seen through an arch of leafy vines, with a figure and a small dog in front.
A sunlit road on a Roman hilltop leading to a church with two bell towers and an obelisk, with a few figures and a pale sky.
Workers with wheelbarrows crossing a snowy building site in front of old brick houses and bare trees in Amsterdam.
A stone terrace of an Italian villa garden with tall umbrella pines, a large urn and a peacock, in warm golden light.
Sailing barges and rowing boats on the grey-silver Thames at Battersea, with factory chimneys along the far shore.
A blue and tan architectural rendering of a planned civic centre, with a domed hall at the end of a broad plaza lined with long buildings.
A wide Paris crossroads on a rainy day, with tall cream buildings, wet cobblestones and people under grey umbrellas.
The weathered brick walls of the ancient palace on Rome's Palatine Hill, overgrown with trees, above a sunny open ground.
A country estate at sunset, with a white house and a domed pavilion among trees beyond a lake crossed by a stone bridge.
